pages.text: Start at the caster's feet using the engine's regular orientation rather than their view direction. Modifiers can change it afterward.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 0. This only chooses where the spell starts.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0. Choosing an origin adds no structural cost.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: Using This Node
pages.text: No more nodes or values are needed here. Insert the gem in its matching slot. Right-click it on the canvas when you want to replace it.
